name: Selank

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic analogue of the immunomodulatory tetrapeptide tuftsin with an added stabilising tripeptide, registered as an anxiolytic in Russia. It has no FDA approval and no approved US labelling. Registered in Russia. No FDA approval; no US labelling exists.

systems.note: Taken for anxiolytic effect via GABAergic and monoaminergic modulation; the intended effect.
Tuftsin origin implies immunomodulatory activity that is not the intended effect.

monitors.why: The accessible instrument for the affective effect claimed.
